dmp.description:
Technology transfer is the process of converting academic discoveries into marketable products and services, serving as a bridge between research and industry. This project aims to create a systemic model for technology transfer and innovation commercialization in Latvian universities and public research institutions, which often face unique challenges due to limited resources and regulatory hurdles. 
Creation of a systemic model for technology transfer and innovation commercialization processes in Latvian research institutions (Nr. LU-BA-PA-2024/1-0042).
